say:1:1012108001:1.text: Oh, no... blessed Misarte! What's going on here?!
say:1:1012108001:1.source_cn: 哦不……弥萨忒保佑！这究竟是怎么回事！

say:2:1012108002:1.text: Outlander... Are you passing through? You shouldn't be in the Vaduso Mountains at this time of year!
say:2:1012108002:1.source_cn: 外乡人……你是旅行者吗？真不凑巧，你不该这时候来瓦度索山脉！
say:2:1012108002:1.male: Outlander... Are you passing through? You shouldn't be in the Vaduso Mountains at this time of year!
say:2:1012108002:1.female: Outlander... Are you passing through? You shouldn't be in the Vaduso Mountains at this time of year!

say:3:1012108003:1.text: Look at the land! What are these horrible black stains?!
say:3:1012108003:1.source_cn: 看看这片土地，看看这些可怕的黑紫色污痕！这都是什么东西？！
say:3:1012108003:1.male: Look at the land! What are these horrible black stains?!
say:3:1012108003:1.female: Look at the land! What are these horrible black stains?!

say:4:1012108004:1.text: They appeared suddenly overnight. Even the village's most experienced apothecaries are at their wits' end about what they are!
say:4:1012108004:1.source_cn: 它们一夜之间突然出现，村子里最有经验的药剂师都拿它们没办法！
say:4:1012108004:1.male: They appeared suddenly overnight. Even the village's most experienced apothecaries are at their wits' end about what they are!
say:4:1012108004:1.female: They appeared suddenly overnight. Even the village's most experienced apothecaries are at their wits' end about what they are!

say:5:1012108005:1.text: A lot of people have been babbling nonsense about this since they appeared! My daughter, <style="highlight">Keya</style>, says there's a black radish that's bigger than she is!
say:5:1012108005:1.source_cn: 自打有了这东西，不少人就开始胡言乱语！我的女儿<sty...
say:5:1012108005:1.male: A lot of people have been babbling nonsense about this since they appeared! My daughter, <style="highlight">Keya</style>, says there's a black radish that's bigger than she is!
say:5:1012108005:1.female: A lot of people have been babbling nonsense about this since they appeared! My daughter, <style="highlight">Keya</style>, says there's a black radish that's bigger than she is!

say:6:1012108006:1.text: I've been picking herbs all my life, and I've never seen a black radish!
say:6:1012108006:1.source_cn: 我采了一辈子药草，从来没见过黑色的葱萝！
say:6:1012108006:1.male: I've been picking herbs all my life, and I've never seen a black radish!
say:6:1012108006:1.female: I've been picking herbs all my life, and I've never seen a black radish!
